items.name: MACAN live in Phuket
items.coordSource: Google Maps place 'Lotus Arena' (7.98485, 98.31006) + OSM node 13476151001 (photon), 3 m apart
items.description: Big solo concert by MACAN, one of the most popular Russian-language artists today. He plays his hits with a full live show at Lotus Arena, a large open-air concert venue in Cherng Talay. Not electronic music, but a big night for Russian-speaking fans. It is on your arrival day.
items.priceText: Early bird: Dance Floor 1,250 THB, Fan Zone 1,900 THB (Megatix, plus 5% fee). Prices go up after each batch.
tips: The price goes up after each ticket batch sells out (organiser).
So far it is only on Megatix. Buy there, not from resellers.
It is your arrival day, so check your flight time first.
items.verification: Megatix page and API (seller ONLYUS Concerts, on sale since 9 Oct): Fri 8 Jan 2027, 7 PM, two early-bird tiers, checked 15 Oct 2026. Not found yet on artist or press channels. Lotus Arena is open-air and active in 2026 (Julian Marley, May 2026). Coords: Google place + OSM node, 3 m apart.

items.name: Spiritgust Festival 2027
items.venue: Beach site in Tha Sala, Nakhon Si Thammarat (exact site TBA)
items.coordSource: wikipedia (Tha Sala district); RA venue pin (8.66, 99.93) agrees. Exact site not published yet.
items.description: Four-day hi-tech psytrance festival from Goa (since 2011), now on a beach in Tha Sala on the Gulf coast. Two stages, beach camping, yoga and workshops. Very fast, intense music, not techno. About 4 hours by road from Phuket, and only the last night overlaps your trip.
items.timeText: Wed 6 to Sat 9 Jan. RA: 6 Jan 11 PM to 9 Jan 6 AM. Set times not out yet.
items.priceText: RA: about 4,100 THB now, about 4,960 THB from 1 Nov, about 5,830 THB from 1 Dec. The official shop charges in Indian rupees (about 4,390 THB from 16 Oct, plus 2.5% fee). Tents cost extra.
tips: Closest airport: Nakhon Si Thammarat (NST), about 40 min. The organiser will run shuttles from NST.
The exact site and map pin will be shared closer to the date.
RA lists it as 18+. Tickets cannot be transferred to another person.
items.verification: Official site data file (lineup, tiers, practical info), FAQ and travel page, plus RA event 2556382 via the RA API, checked 15 Oct 2026. Two stages, yoga and workshops are listed as confirmed. Exact site not published. RA and official start/end times differ.

items.name: Carl Cox at Café del Mar
items.venue: Café del Mar Phuket, Pyramid Stage

items.gmapsQuery: Café del Mar Phuket Beach Club, Kamala, Phuket
items.description: Techno and house legend Carl Cox returns to the open-air Pyramid Stage at Café del Mar, with Nic Fanciulli playing before him. Beach-club show from afternoon to night, then an after-party inside. It is five days before you arrive, so only if you change your flights.
items.timeText: Sun 3 Jan, 2 PM - 10:30 PM; after-party in the Club Room from 11 PM
items.priceText: Megatix: Early Bird 1,900 THB (4 PM entry), 1st Release 2,500 THB (6 PM entry). The 1,600 THB presale is sold out. After-party only: 1,200 THB.
tips: Strictly 20+. Bring ID.
Each ticket has an entry time. If you come late, you can be refused or pay a 1,000 THB late fee.
items.verification: Café del Mar page, Megatix API and RA API all say Sun 3 Jan 2027, 2 PM - 10:30 PM (checked 15 Oct 2026). Megatix tiers checked: the 1,600 THB presale is sold out and 1,200 THB is the after-party-only ticket. Coords: venue schema.org geo, Google place and OSM within 10 m.

items.name: DnB Allstars Thailand 2027
items.coordSource: Megatix venue record 'Azulea Phuket Thailand' = plus code R9R8+2RP (decoded). Fits the partner hotels' walk times (TAVANA about 500 m = '7 min', Rom Reun about 900 m = '10 min'). No Google or OSM place named Azulea.
items.description: Three days of drum and bass at Azulea, an open-air venue in the forest in Chalong, south Phuket. Pendulum (DJ set) is the first name, with 50+ international artists promised. Two stages, Void sound system, about 3,000 ravers and afterparties. It starts four days after your trip ends.
items.timeText: Fri 22 Jan 4 PM - 11 PM; Sat 23 and Sun 24 Jan 2 PM - 11 PM; afterparties
items.priceText: 3-day GA 10,900 THB or £229; VIP 14,900 THB or £319 (3rd release, Oct 2026), plus fees. Inner Circle 22,900 THB. The price rises with each release.
tips: Strictly 20+. Photo ID is checked.
Payment plans must be paid off by 16 Dec 2026.
No parking at the venue. Take a taxi or Grab.
items.verification: Official sites (dnballstars-thailand.com home, FAQ and accommodation; dnballstars.com event page) and the Megatix API (THB shop), checked 15 Oct 2026. Dates, times, 20+ rule, payment-plan deadline and prices match. Pin from the organiser's plus code; no public map place for Azulea.

items.description: The Tulum festival brand Zamna comes to Phuket for the first time: two days at Yeden Gardens near Natai Beach. Zamna is known for big stage design and sound, and for melodic techno and house. No lineup yet. The ticket site says Fri 29 and Sat 30 Jan, after your trip.
items.timeText: Fri 29 Jan from 4 PM to Sat 30 Jan, midnight
items.priceText: Tier 1: GA 3,200 THB, 2-day GA 4,700 THB, VIP 9,500 THB, 2-day VIP 13,000 THB
tips: 20+ only.
Some pages still say 23-24 Jan. The ticket site (Ticketmelon) says 29-30 Jan.

items.name: Full Moon Party
items.venue: Haad Rin Nok (Sunrise Beach), Haad Rin
items.coordSource: wikipedia (Hat Rin) + OSM beach Haad Rin Nok (photon) + Google 'Rin Nok Beach', all within 25 m
items.gmapsQuery: Haad Rin Nok Beach, Koh Phangan
items.description: The world-famous all-night beach party on Haad Rin. Thousands of travellers, neon paint, fire shows and many sound systems playing EDM, house, techno, hip-hop and party hits. Fun to see once, but the opposite of underground. Four days after your trip ends.
items.timeText: Fri 22 Jan, about 9 PM until sunrise
items.priceText: Entry about 200 THB, cash at the beach gate. No online tickets.
tips: The full moon is on Fri 22 Jan 2027 (7:17 PM Thai time).
Jungle Experience usually runs the night before.
Bring cash and wear closed shoes. There is broken glass on the beach.
items.verification: 22 Jan 2027 on the fullmoonparty-thailand.com schedule (dates from the Haad Rin Business Association), phangan.events and thaiest.com (updated 27 Sep 2026). Full moon computed at 7:17 PM Thai time on 22 Jan. Coords: Wikipedia, OSM beach and Google within 25 m.

items.name: Jungle Experience
items.coordSource: Official site Google Maps link (place 'Jungle Experience', !3d9.715354!4d100.0299359) + phangan.events plus code P28H+4X, 5 m apart

items.description: Koh Phangan's classic jungle rave: two stages with house, techno and drum and bass, fire shows and a pro Muay Thai ring, from 10 PM to sunrise. The January 2027 date is not announced yet. It is usually the night before the Full Moon Party, so most likely Thu 21 Jan.
items.priceText: Regular 2026 nights: early bird 850 THB, GA 1,000 THB online (1 free drink). Special nights cost more (30 Dec: GA up to 1,400 THB).
tips: Buy only on jungle-experience.com or Megatix (official warning).
Combo tickets with a boat from Koh Samui are sold on their site.
items.verification: Not yet on jungle-experience.com or Megatix (last date listed: 30 Dec 2026, checked 15 Oct 2026). Each 2026 edition (26 Oct, 23 Nov, 23 Dec) is the night before the Full Moon Party, so 21 Jan is likely but not confirmed. Coords: official site Google Maps link + plus code.
